_metadata.description: Cross-platform desktop architecture. First-release contract; completion follows requirement-linked behavior and retained protocol evidence.

requirements.title: The runtime shall separate portable semantics from platform adapters.
requirements.description: The desktop/runtime contracts shall support Windows, macOS and Linux paths, process control, storage, secure-store and renderer availability with explicit per-platform capability states from the initial implementation.

validation.notes: NOT EXECUTED. Follow the named DS-DESKTOP-ARCHITECTURE protocol, including its counterexample, and retain actual inputs, commands, receipts, results and reviewer verdict. The protocol is a verification plan, not passing evidence.

metadata.planned_automation: Cross-platform build/contract tests and native platform matrix review.

requirements.title: The desktop bundle shall run without the development checkout.
requirements.description: The private bundle shall include required UI/API/state/composition and qualified FFmpeg/FFprobe artifacts and declared optional renderer/service packs using per-user mutable storage and immutable checked assets.

metadata.planned_automation: Fresh-user packaged smoke/offline/path and artifact-closure checks.

requirements.title: The worker shall use qualified owner-managed renderer artifacts.
requirements.description: Before rendering, the worker shall resolve pinned tool/runtime/library/kernel artifacts through existing provisioning owners and report hardware, compiled backend, enumeration, capacity admission and render qualification separately.

requirements.title: The desktop shall preserve data across offline restart and update.
requirements.description: For each advertised platform, the packaged app shall qualify signed distribution, private loopback/lifecycle isolation, secure-store behavior, restart, update/migration and clean owned shutdown while preserving projects.
